title: Head turning
intro: A dot that stays put in the room while you turn your head. Keep your eyes on it.

steps.text: Keep looking at the dot. Turn your head slowly left and right.
Keep looking at the dot. Nod slowly up and down.
Keep looking at the dot. Tilt your head side to side.
Keep looking at the dot. Shake your head a little, quickly.
If you have room: take a step to each side while looking at the dot.
